text:
Maya: Heads up — candidate accepted but asked for a $15k sign-on to start next week. We’re currently at a $10k band cap for the role. Can we route an exception?

Evan: That candidate is tied to the West Coast pilot. If they don’t start 4/1 we’ll miss a key delivery milestone. Manager is asking to bump to $15k and front-load 50% on first paycheck.

Tom (Recruiter): Candidate signed offer this morning at 9:12 am. They want a 4/1 start. I can push the start if comp holds, but manager is pushing for earlier ramp.

Maya: Okay — two asks: 1) approval to exceed band cap by $5k (one-time sign-on) and 2) confirmation we can pay 50% on first paycheck (payroll/proration check).

Priya: Payroll note — we can split sign-on across payrolls, but if >$10k we need CFO or Comp Committee sign-off for audit trail and budget code. Also need GL code, will need to tag as "sign-on bonus" for Q2.

Evan: Manager justification (short): "Critical customer project: backfill to avoid contract penalty; candidate brings domain expertise; ramp time <6w." Is that enough?

Maya: Yes that justification works. Please paste into the comp exception form. Link to form: https://redwood.intra/comp-exceptions

Tom (Recruiter): Pasting comp worksheet snippet:
```
Base: $160,000
Level: L5
Band cap sign-on: $10,000
Requested sign-on: $15,000
Payment split: 50% first paycheck, 50% after 30 days
Justification: Critical pilot coverage; starts 4/1 to hit milestone
```

People Ops Bot: Reminder — routing rules: exceptions >$10k require Comp Committee + Finance. Add manager + hiring manager approvals, attach signed offer, and ping @comp-committee.

Maya: I’ve uploaded the form and attached the signed offer in the ticket. Ticket: HR-827. Routing to @comp-committee and @finance for final review.

Priya: I’ll review GL coding and confirm payroll proration can split on next two pay runs. If committee approves today we can process for 4/1.

Evan: Thanks Priya — can you also confirm whether FICA/withholding differs if we front-load 50%?

Priya: No change to withholding rates. We’ll run standard tax withholdings on each sign-on tranche.

Tom (Recruiter): Candidate ok to start 4/1 pending approvals. They agreed to remote onboarding.

Maya: Noted. One procedural thing — because this pushes us over band for L5, comp committee please consider whether to also set a precedent for future pilot hires. Recommendation: mark as "one-off" and attach lesson learned.

People Ops Bot: Comp Committee pinged: @comp-committee. Agenda item created for emergency review.

Evan: If approved, please approve budget code redirection to team 1402 (Pilot).

Priya: Will confirm GL string once committee signs off.

Maya: Thanks all. If committee approves, I’ll update offer addendum and confirm start with candidate. :thumbsup:

Tom (Recruiter): FYI — candidate said they’ll accept addendum via DocuSign today if we can confirm by 5pm PST.

Maya: Understood — escalating to comp committee chair via DM.

People Ops Bot: Update: Chair acknowledged, will try to get a decision before 17:00 PST.

Evan: Appreciated. Leaving here for now — ping me if anything else is needed.

Maya: Closing loop later with final status. (Will post final decision in this thread.)
